normalizedDocument.artCanvasBasis: Root production allocation: square 14×14 grid rounds sqrt(0.75)×16 up to whole 4K tiles. This is a raster production choice, not a user-specified world size.
normalizedDocument.ratioExplanation: User's 3/4 applies to world area. A 14×14 square raster has 49/64 of the main city's pixels; eventual world mapping preserves 3/4 area without distorting the artwork, with about 1.04% more pixels per world unit. No capacity gain is claimed.

coordinateSystem.overviewMapping: uniform 1254 square -> 57344 square, crop guides are layout-only; not final pixels

constraints: daylight only; rounded full Q Daoist painterly art matching approved mail style and map references
Spring Festival architecture: ivory walls/vermilion dados, red doors, window papercuts, couplets, lanterns
Lantern Festival and Mid-Autumn objects mixed sparingly, no separate festival districts
natural pale grey/blue-grey stone slabs and low-contrast joints; no red paving; retain appropriate wood/sand
scattered spent red firecracker scraps, small scorched tubes, wall-side firework boxes; do not clog routes
trees only beside existing buildings/courtyard walls; no free-standing plaza/street tree islands or potted trees
roads, courtyard openings, stairs and quay routes visually continuous; no navigation pass inferred
no NPCs, UI, grid labels, watermarks, giant icons or invented map names baked into art

ownership.crossZoneBorderRule: Read and reference recorded adjacent native pieces when available. Unreviewed cross-zone edges remain candidates. Root reviews shared seams.

acceptance: native detail redrawn, never enlarge a low-resolution overview and call it finished
internal patch geometry and joins visually checked at native resolution
4096 square tile fully covered with source hashes and native contribution traceability
external tile/zone joins checked before formal acceptance
per-image actual prompt, reference roles/hashes, native dimensions, receipt, submitted selectors and actual model/quality evidence
normalizedDocument.detailReferencePurpose: independent style close-up, NOT a coordinate crop
mapSpecificConstraints: eight separate immortal residences, four per side, with existing identity props and open courtyards; do not merge or add residences
north central main hall, south-west lotus pavilion and south gate are extra buildings, not part of the eight residences
central taiji plaza, cross roads and circulation around all courtyards remain continuous
southeast dock and short south route toward main city's north gate preserved
no enlarged coast or gate exterior; no free-standing coastal trees restored
